authorization: User-authorized limited sentence erasure/replacement and attachment removal/return; no free-form rewriting.

constraints.reference_motion_claim: This is a user-authorized Solmere design, not a claimed frame-by-frame observation of Forgery Craft.

slots.original: I am not asking you to stay because I am afraid of what happens after you go.

options.label: 擦去这一句
options.meaning_preview: 寄出的信里不再有这句对挽留动机的说明，见面邀请仍然保留。

options.label: 替换这一句
options.text: I am asking you to stay because I am afraid of what happens after you go.
options.meaning_preview: 把“我不是因为害怕才求你留下”改成“我因为害怕而求你留下”。其余信文不变。

attachment.label: 灯塔照片
attachment.caption: 小幅灯塔照片
attachment.remove_preview: 照片留在工作面上；若未放回，它不会随信送出。
attachment.return_preview: 把这张原照片放回信中，恢复本次寄送的附件完整性。

options.label: 擦去这一句
options.meaning_preview: 寄出的旧信里不再有这句明确让对方离开的表示；前后的愤怒和不愿施压仍在。

options.label: 替换这一句
options.meaning_preview: 把当年的“要走就走吧”改成“要走也先等等”。它不会改变这封旧信的日期。

case02_request_erased.feedback: Mira把信折好：“信里还是约我上去。好，我知道了。”
case02_request_erased.evidence_basis: Remaining text still invites Mira to the lookout before the last shuttle; the deleted sentence is not known to her.

case02_request_changed.feedback: Mira又看了一遍那一行：“这是在叫我留下。我还是得听对方当面说。”
case02_request_changed.evidence_basis: The received sentence now explicitly asks her to stay. This does not reveal an alteration or establish the unnamed sender's identity.

case04_departure_erased.feedback: “她那时很生气。”June把信收起来，“我记得。别的，我得自己问。”
case04_departure_erased.evidence_basis: The remaining letter still describes anger and attachment. June cannot quote the removed sentence or know who removed it.

case04_departure_changed.feedback: June的指尖停在那句话上：“她叫我等。我一直以为那天已经说完了。”她没有接着解释。
case04_departure_changed.evidence_basis: June reads the altered historical request to wait. Her memory differs, but she has no automatic knowledge of the original wording or the player's intervention.

case03_photo_missing.feedback: June摸了摸空信封：“信里说给我留了一张，里面却没有。也许夹漏了，我回头问问。”
case03_photo_missing.evidence_basis: The unchanged body promises a photograph, while the actual delivered envelope lacks it. This proves a discrepancy, not who caused it.

case03_photo_present.feedback: June把照片夹回信里：“她说会留一张，真的留了。”
case03_photo_present.evidence_basis: The original photograph is present when June opens the delivered envelope. Its earlier removal and return are not automatically known to her.

detection.generic_feedback: 对方把纸转向光：“这里像是擦过。你知道是怎么回事吗？”
detection.attribution: A visible trace permits a question about handling, not automatic knowledge of the author of the change or the original sentence.
detection.penalty_policy: No penalty is applied by this content file. Only an actual detection event may invoke the core's established evidence-based work/trust policy.
